title: Her desk, never seen
logline: Chloe's desk in a Seattle office, invented from the one sentence in 2013 about a job she didn't describe: a monitor off, a mug, a window with the water, and on the partition wall a small pinned strip too far to read. He gives her one of his; the page doesn't say which.

panels.composition: An office cubicle: a dark monitor, a mug, a window with gray water beyond, and on the fabric partition a small pinned newspaper strip too far away to read.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an office cubicle with a dark monitor, a mug and a window showing gray water, a small newspaper comic strip pinned to the fabric partition too far away to read, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: One of his, pinned. Which: reserved.
